title: Minor actions tab 3 dot menu bug
symptom: In the Actions tab, tapping the 3-dot menu shows preferences for actions, but the options cannot be tapped or opened.
cause: The 'Action pref' line appears in the menu list but is unclickable, likely a styling issue.
evidence_quote: The bug is that the "Action pref" line is in the list of the menu. Unclicable but there ;)
